Schema is explicitly documented in the two docs and enforced with exact fields:
strata.fixed-history-production-sidecar.v1; pin actual owner source and persisted commands object, command index, complete effective environment, artifacts capture/binary/source/runtime/generator/verifier/prompt/follow/input-manifest/stdout/stderr/provider, model identity manifest, identities pre/post hashes, fresh same-boot fault/health collectors, close receipt, budget/consumer/retire_after.

Checks implemented in source, all runtime unverified:
- Actual owner closure flags observation/reap/session-empty/session-anchor; observed identity registration, errors/cleanup/survivors empty, integer exit 0, UTC command interval.
- Conservative standalone argv allowlist rejects duplicates and unsupported serve/MTP/EOS/prefill-until/early-stop. Explicit spec >=2, N>=2, exact N/max-context/stride1, tokens-file/follow/capture actual paths, native/pack/profile/cache/prefill, suffix/lookup/adapt disabled.
- Command SHA compact argv JSON, exact full environment receipt identity, segmented=1/device-plan=0, forbidden preload/probe/bench overrides.
- All local pin SHA identities, pre/post immutable source/binary/runtime/providers/history. Output capture/log pre hash null denotes absent before launch; post matches pin. Model manifest binds full external pre/post file inventory without reading huge tensors.
- Exact actual segmented init stderr line from verifier source, owner log SHA/size, stdout full prompt/output IDs, N decode count, dump completion. Error diagnostic terms reject.
- Same boot, fresh fault/health interval enclosing launch/completion within 60 seconds margin, complete collectors, empty normalized arrays matching pinned collector JSON, capture-close command/hash/time/error/status binding.
- Exact raw FP32 header/bytes before hashing and full streaming finite scan, positions P-1+i and follow targets derived; budget <=1GiB and vocab<=2097152, JSON/log byte limits, rehash evidence after inspection.
- Duplicate JSON keys, missing/unlisted schema fields and inconsistent evidence reject.

IMPORTANT authenticity boundary:
REVIEWED_PRODUCERS is intentionally empty. Even schema-valid evidence or evidence_kind production cannot set production_capture_qualified true. Adapter receipt may say adapter_schema_validated true; production_capture_qualified and quality_qualified remain false in current code. Fixture patches owner hash only inside tests and cannot qualify production. A sidecar author can fabricate internally consistent evidence, and pinned owner code does not prove that code actually ran. Registering a producer without auditing a real controller would violate the requested gate. This implementation prepares strict adapter/receipt plumbing but intentionally leaves real runtime qualification blocked until Main's actual producer/controller and collectors are available and reviewed. It does not silently manufacture qualified:true.

Future controller still must implement/preserve actual owner commands receipt, complete effective ENV, immutable source-to-binary build manifest, runtime loaded-library identity/resolution, pre/post all model shard/pack/profile inventory, outputs absent before launch, close-after-reap observation, boot identity, genuinely complete fresh kernel cursor/health collection and tamper-resistant association. No real producer/capture presently exists. The normalized empty JSON collectors are bound structurally, but semantic completeness of collectors and opaque source/runtime envelope are not independently attested by this source-only adapter. Full artifact duplicates are checked, but native model tensor byte/hash values are accepted only as external pre/post receipt evidence as requested; actual tensor files are not opened. This is documented, and false qualification prevents overclaim.

No persistent GDN/QSA/PLE snapshot parser, no RESTORE state comparison, no heldout task quality, no adoption decision, no exact prose quality gate. Existing numerical comparator flags remain fixed false. This diagnostic does not time or replace upstream bench.sh; stock approximately32K eligibility is >=32000, while historical strict32768 false field remains unchanged. R365's 32049<32768 blanket benchmark invalidity wording is obsolete; no performance result changed here. Supplied registry v185/count894 remains untouched and was not reprocessed.
